title: Saudi Arabia Sparks Oil Price War - Implications For The Tanker Market
section_path: Saudi Arabia Sparks Oil Price War - Implications For The Tanker Market
section_path_text: Saudi Arabia Sparks Oil Price War - Implications For The Tanker Market
summary: Over the weekend, Saudi Aramco sent shockwaves through global markets as it announced steep discounts to its official selling price for April, igniting a price war among major global producers. Consequently, oil prices are down significantly. At the time of writing, WTI and Brent prices are in the low to mid $30s per barrel, down 25% and 24% respectively.

children.section_path_text: How will the tanker market react?
children.summary: • Short term (<3 months) : Increasing oil supply at significantly lower prices in a market with weak demand fundamentals should lead to an increase in demand for floating storage. We are seeing several deals being negotiated for short-term (6-12 months) charters, with one already concluded.
